integrity: A full mathematical argument and a standalone diagnostic checker are supplied. Computational checks cannot establish universal correctness or novelty.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic statements concern fixed rank or ranks growing more slowly than the square root of ambient dimension; the critical and dense regimes are not resolved. The general finite-rank formula is an exact expectation rather than an elementary closed form. The rank-one special case and Gaussian-block approximation are established prior work. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
title: Minimal first-harmonic projections on real Grassmannians: a strict rank hierarchy
